text:
Ravi: Who stole the office flaky sea salt? I opened the snack drawer and it was gone. :face_with_raised_eyebrow:
Maya: lol that was me, I used it on my avocado toast this morning. I left a note but maybe it fell off. Sorry!
Oliver: Can we start a tiny 'seasoning fund' jar so people can replace staples? I can toss in $5.
Ravi: Love that. Maybe label it 'kitchen supplies' and keep receipts in the drawer.
Maya: I'll grab a replacement container on my way out at 5. Also can someone pick up coffee filters? We're down to 3.
Oliver: Adding filters and a roll of paper towels to my errands list. Anyone want anything else?
kitchen-bot: Reminder: please wipe counters after food prep. Weekly inventory on Fridays.
Ravi: Also quick etiquette: if you take the last of something (milk, filters), please leave a sticky note or message in this channel. Helps avoid sad cereal mornings. :bowl_with_spoon:
Maya: Agreed. New rule: name-and-date label on opened jars. I'll print some sticker labels and put them by the printer.
Oliver: Sticker plan sounds good. I'll bring a small mason jar for the seasoning fund and leave a spare $10 to start.
Ravi: Awesome, thanks. If anyone wants me to pick up anything from the corner store at 4pm, ping me here.
Maya: Could you grab oat milk and a pack of plain crackers? Thanks!
Oliver: I fixed the broken sugar scoop this morning btw, it's back in the sugar tin.
kitchen-bot: FYI: deep-clean scheduled next Wednesday at 6pm. If you have personal items in the fridge, label them.
